name: 3D Production Resource Source Policy
principle: A curated list can guide discovery without granting rights to the resources it links to.

sources.notes: The Awesome Blender list is CC0 and is used as a pinned discovery/taxonomy source. The Vault does not mirror its images or treat linked projects as CC0.

requirementsBeforeProductionUse: Open the selected resource's own official repository/site and verify its current licence or terms.
Verify whether commercial use, modification, redistribution, asset embedding and generated-output use are allowed for the intended project.
Check maintenance status, Blender/runtime compatibility, export format support and security risk before installation.
Record provenance for models, textures, HDRIs, audio, datasets, scans and generated assets separately from tool/source-code provenance.
Do not redistribute paid, account-gated or restricted assets through the Vault.
Do not assume a GitHub repository or a free download is commercially reusable merely because it is publicly accessible.

realWorldRepresentationPolicy: For a real product, property, venue, facility, person or geographic site, prefer verified geometry, approved photography/scans, owner-supplied CAD/BIM/GIS data or clearly licensed source data.
Procedural or generated geometry must not be presented as an accurate digital twin unless it was validated against authoritative source data.
Photogrammetry, maps, LiDAR and height-map sources may carry privacy, location, platform or dataset-specific restrictions that must be checked separately.
vaultBoundary: The Vault stores its own production categories, selection rules, workflow guidance and source links.
The Vault does not mirror third-party Blender add-ons, models, textures, HDRIs, datasets, tutorials or commercial downloads by default.
A selected external resource is a candidate for due diligence, not an approved dependency or asset.
